result:
Small order-utilities module: computes an order total (`calcTotal`), applies percentage discount codes (`applyDiscount`), computes average item price, and formats an order as text with the discounted total.

Bugs:

1. `calcTotal` (test/orders.js:5) — loop uses `i <= items.length`, reading one past the end; `items[items.length]` is undefined, so `.price` throws a TypeError on every call.
2. `averageItemPrice` (test/orders.js:20) — divides by `items.length` with no empty check, returning `NaN` for `[]` (and it inherits the crash from bug 1).
3. `calcTotal` makes `NaN` easy to propagate silently if `price`/`qty` are missing — minor, but `total.toFixed(2)` in `formatOrder` would then throw nothing and print `NaN`.

Bug 1 is the correctness-critical one; fixing the loop to `i < items.length` fixes both call sites.
